# 2 Clement — Chapter 18 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 18
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Let us be among those who give thanks — those who have served God — and not among the lawless who face judgment.
2. I speak as a fellow sinner. I have not escaped temptation. I am still caught in the devil's nets. But I am pressing forward, trying to pursue righteousness, hoping at least to draw near to it — because the coming judgment fills me with fear.
